text:
sasha-sales: Heads-up: CarePort asked for a 5-week POC. They want recommended reserved GPU commit, autoscale guidance, and confirmation of what we can include in the POC (VPC peering + SOC2 artifacts). Workload: session chat + embedding lookups. Steady ~160 rps, bursts up to ~1k rps for ~8-12m, avg payload ~110 tokens. Any immediate blockers?

nate-sre: No hard blockers. Quick sizing rule: with q4 quant we estimate ~340 rps per GPU for short chats. For steady 160 rps, 2 GPUs minimal, but for predictable latency and safety propose 4 reserved + autoscale to 10 for bursts. Spread across AZs (min 1 per AZ).

priya-runtime: +1. Also recommend locking model+quant in the agreement (e.g., clarity-1.0, q4_0) so perf is stable. Add preheat_window and KV prefill to avoid spike tail latency. Sample autoscale snippet we use in presales: 
```
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: "1"
  reserved_replicas: "4"
  max_replicas: "10"
  target_rps_per_gpu: "320"
  preheat_window: "5m"
  scale_window: "60s"
  cooldown: "90s"
  az_spread: "true"
```

omar-solutions: For the POC offer: propose 4 reserved GPUs + 6 burstable, a capped burst-credit pool (we suggest 5k burst-minutes for a 5-week ramp), and a 48hr smoke test run against golden prompts before customer go/no-go. We'll supply the runbook and the load generator.

felix-pricing: Pricing: 4 reserved GPUs monthly + burst usage billed at on-demand with the capped credit pool. If customer wants SLA tighter than our default POC targets, we need higher commit or premium SLA fee. I can prepare two quote lines: standard POC and SLA-upgrade option. Need estimated burst minutes per week to finalize numbers.

sasha-sales: They estimate 2-4 bursts/day early on, ~10min each. That maps to ~20-40 min/day on ramp.

priya-runtime: Good. We should also include circuit-breaker rules and a fallback model path to keep tail latency bounded if queue_depth spikes. And pin the model rollout.

laura-security: SOC2 docs available. For VPC peering we need their CIDR ranges and POA for peering. Customer-managed KMS/HSM is enterprise-only (longer lead). For POC we can provide sanitized audit samples and encrypted logs.

sasha-sales: Legal asked if we can commit to 99.9% availability during business hours and a 50p latency SLA of 100ms for embeddings, 250ms for chat. Are those reasonable?

priya-runtime: Embeddings 100ms 50p is realistic with proper reserved commit. Chat 250ms 50p is reasonable for shorter contexts; for 110 tokens it should be fine with the reserved pool + preheat. 100ms for chat 50p is not feasible without distilled model and much higher reserved commit. Recommend offering standard SLA (embeddings 100ms, chat 250ms) and a premium SLA (tighter numbers + more reserved GPUs).

felix-pricing: Ill prepare both price scenarios. Note: premium SLA implies priority routing and capacity reservation so the reserved rate increases ~1.6x.

nate-sre: Ops checklist to include in quote/runbook:
- provide VPC peering instructions and IP allowlist window
- schedule three daily preheat runs during ramp week
- enable queue-depth and GPU saturation alerts (pager on 95p latency breaches)
- smoke test with golden prompt set and share results before milestone sign-off

omar-solutions: Next steps I propose: 1) Ill draft the POC runbook and load scripts, 2) nate will stage sandbox reserved pool and post the smoke-run command, 3) felix will attach pricing lines (std + premium), 4) laura will attach SOC2 + dataflow summary.

sasha-sales: Great. Ill ask CarePort for CIDRs and confirm burst cadence. Thanks team — tagging next: @omar-solutions @nate-sre @felix-pricing @laura-security. :thumbsup:
